sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to an intermittent sentence and he has been on bail since the trial.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed on s. 11(b); intermittent sentence length not shown.

sentence_quote: a sentence of one day in prison would have been sufficient. I substitute that term for the three month sentence imposed by the sentencing judge.
note: Three months reduced to one day, execution stayed; probation removed.

offence_note: Possession of loaded prohibited or restricted firearm
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to four years, 5 months and 8 days less 2 years, 5 months and 9 days of pre-sentence credit.

offence_note: Shoplifting, high-speed chase, striking police officer with car
sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced the appellant to four years and eight months in custody, after giving one year and four months’ credit for pre-trial custody.
note: Six offences not itemised; total before credit computed as 4y8m plus 1y4m.

sentence_quote: The sentencing judge imposed a sentence of 12 years, reduced to eight years and eight months for time served on remand.
note: 20 months remand credited at double (40 months).

offence_note: Fraud, false pretences, breach of probation, failure to attend court
sentence_quote: On January 7, 1994, after taking time to consider, Judge Gibson suspended the passing of sentence and placed the respondent on probation for three years with a series of strict conditions.
note: Crown appeal dismissed; community service ordered, hours not stated.

offence_note: Two second degree murders and attempted murder
sentence_quote: I would dismiss the conviction appeal but allow the sentence appeal, set aside the 18-year parole ineligibility period and substitute a parole ineligibility period of 13 years.
systemic_quote: The majority take the view that the period of parole ineligibility imposed rendered the sentence demonstrably unfit having regard to the appellant’s youth, lack of a prior record, his highly intoxicated and agitated state, the systemic impacts of colonization and his immediate remorse.
note: Concurrent 10-year term for attempted murder; majority reduced parole ineligibility from 18 to 13 years.

sentence_quote: The sentence imposed was appropriately within the range of sentences for similar offences and similar offenders. I would dismiss the appeal.
note: Sentencing judge erred in principle but sentence not unfit.

offence_note: Arson (hiring another to set fire to a home)
sentence_quote: I would dismiss the appeal against conviction. I would grant leave but dismiss the appeal against sentence.
note: Co-accused Robar set the fire; Veinot's sentence only.

sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal, allow the appeal and vary the custodial sentence to time served.
note: 18 months reduced to time served on fresh psychiatric evidence; probation cut from 3 to 2 years.

offence_note: Aggravated assault by HIV exposure through unprotected sex
sentence_quote: a sentence of 49 months less seven months (representing double the three and a half months dead time already served) was required. Thus the final sentence was 42 months.
note: Appeal on joint submission ground dismissed; assault and threatening charges stayed.
